title: the long a sound
parentNote: Today is the odd one out: the sound is the long a — the ay in they, in rain, in cake — and the course has not yet given your child a single way to spell it, so this is a listening day, and tomorrow the spelling arrives. The game is the whole lesson: say a pair of words and ask whether the a says aah or says its own name. cat and cake. hat and hate. tap and tape. plan and plane. Stretch the long one until it is silly — aaaay — because a child who cannot hear the difference cannot use tomorrow's rule however well they learn it. What is on the screen today is this week's long i and long o words, because they are the same trick with a different vowel: the vowel stops saying its everyday sound and says its own name instead. Read those out loud and tomorrow's silent e on an a will feel obvious rather than arbitrary.

activities.prompt: You can read this one already. Say it slowly and stretch the end: thaaay. That ay is the sound we are hunting today.
Now the everyday a, the one in cat. Tap it. It is the sound that ay is hiding behind.
Two letters, one sound: the i saying its own name.
Same shape of word, but now it is the o saying its own name.
A quiet e on the end, so the i says its name in the middle.
A long one with two vowels in it. The first one is short and the second one says its name.
Listen to the middle sound. Short, or the vowel saying its name?
Listen to the middle sound. Short, or the vowel saying its name?
One of these is a coin. It is the one with the silent e on the end.

activities.text: They hid a bone in a hole, and the dog dug it up.
At bedtime, Meg rode home on a bike.
The mole sat up on a stone and did grin at them!

activities.title: Tim hides at bedtime
activities.prompt: Read the story one line at a time. Tap any word you want to hear again.
lines: It is bedtime, and Tim did hide inside the shed.
Mum and Meg did not spot him.
They did hunt in the pine and up the slope.
Then Meg did spot ten toes in the gap!
Tim did grin and did not run.
At nine Tim is in bed, and the dog hid inside the shed.
